protocol.actual_viscosity: 1; other positive viscosities in manufactured identities only
protocol.current_input: complete current A,B,p0 and all fixed Cartesian residual/endpoint jets, not older hypothetical hierarchy
protocol.diagnostic_field: manufactured complete current-endpoint potential/direct swirl/pressure on actual implicit q, including t=1 away from origin
protocol.extension_diagonal: spatial_order+time_order<=floor(j/2); derivative tail bounded by sum 2^-j
protocol.force_extension: sum_(j>=0) chi0(b_j*sigma)*sigma^j/j!*F_j; b0=2; increasing dyadic bj
protocol.localized_field: u=curl(c*A)+c*B=c*u0+d; p=c*p0; d=grad(c) cross A; c axisymmetric
protocol.pressure: same full p_B tails and every wave/mean pressure difference; forced Poisson includes -div f
protocol.scope: conditional current compact smooth force, zero datum, preterminal energy/dissipation and preserved core growth; not global competitor exclusion or unconditional blow-up

current_domain_and_support.cutoff: c=chi_r(r^2)*chi_z(z)*chi_t(t); compact axisymmetric support and inner plateau

global_terminal_force_jets.terminal_jets: F_j=lim_(t->1-) partial_t^j f in C_c^infinity(K); D_x^alpha F_j(0)=0
global_terminal_force_jets.uniform_gluing: small ball uses flat complete residual; K outside ball uses current punctured endpoint limits; off K is zero

one_smooth_force_extension.tail: for fixed a,m and J>=max(1,2*(a+m)), sum_(j>=J) ||D_x^a partial_sigma^m T_j||<=2^(1-J)
